newsitem.title: USA: SL Industries stake raised by Steel Partners.
newsitem.headline: SL Industries stake raised by Steel Partners.

text.p: A group including Steel Partners II Lp and investor Warren Lichtenstein said Friday it had increased its stake in SL Industries Inc's outstanding common shares to six percent or 345,100 shares and may try to seek control of the company.

Lichtenstein, who has been a member of SL's board since 1993, said he has been in talks with the company and plans to do so again about the company's business operations and ways to enhance stockholder value, according to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Lichtenstein said he may propose a stock buyback program by the company, a recapitalization, a sale of the company's core businesses, expansion of operations, or even a sale of the company entirely.
His group said in the SEC filing it will "actively monitor efforts by management to increase stock holder value" and may seek control of the company in addition to more board representation.
Most recently, the group bought 113,600 shares of the Mount Laurel, N.J. maker of electrical products between April 21 and June 20 at $6.935 to $9.902 each.
